items.name: Cumin Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Prepare the well-dried cooked chickpeas and dry the surfaces well.
Toss with the olive oil, cumin seeds, and rock salt.
Spread in one layer on a wide tray.
Roast until hot and lightly crisp, turning midway so the edges color evenly.
Serve warm in a modest portion.
items.guidance: Cumin Roasted Chickpeas is roasted rather than deep-fried and is best served warm. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

Brush with the remaining olive oil and bake or griddle until cooked through and lightly browned.
